subject: Startup accelerator - credit velocity, metering carveouts & retention incentive
messages:
From: Michelle Park <michelle@lumen.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-14 09:12 -0700
Subject: Startup accelerator - credit velocity, metering carveouts & retention incentive

Hi Vivek,

Thanks again for admitting LumenAI into Redwood's accelerator cohort — really excited to get started. We pushed our beta to a handful of customers last week and expect a concentrated spike in token consumption during our public launch window (day 0–45).

Quick ask: given the bursty nature of our roadmap, would Redwood consider a one-time acceleration in free credits for launch velocity? Specifically: an upfront top-up (~150k token-equivalent), leniency on per-minute metering spikes for the first 45 days (so we don't get throttled by brief demo days), and a small retention incentive (e.g., additional credits or discounted overage if we convert to paid within 180 days).

I've attached a short usage forecast (LumenAI-usage-forecast.csv) and a simple conversion plan. We're flexible on the structure — open to staged vesting or capped slabs — but we need predictability so engineering can enable features.

Can you tell me what exceptions Redwood has granted historically (if any), how quickly these can be approved, and what the legal/billing hooks look like? We're trying to avoid a slow procurement cycle right before launch.

Thanks,
Michelle Park
Head of Partnerships, LumenAI
michelle@lumen.ai

---
Attachment: LumenAI-usage-forecast.csv (csv)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Michelle Park <michelle@lumen.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-14 11:03 -0700
Subject: Re: Startup accelerator - credit velocity, metering carveouts & retention incentive

Michelle — thanks for the context and for the forecast. This is the kind of concrete ask that's easy to evaluate.

High level: we can consider a provisional velocity top-up plus a conversion-linked retention incentive, but we'll need: (1) usage breakouts by API route (embed/generate/chat), (2) a proposed conversion trigger and timeline, and (3) a clear definition of "metering leniency" (e.g., spike windows, duration, and hard caps).

I've looped Marissa (pricing/programs) and Ben (billing/finance) to scope what a promotional carveout would look like operationally. Lauren — legal — fyi.

Next steps: Marissa/Ben, can you review the attached forecast and tell Michelle what a provisional top-up would look like (suggested: 150k token-equivalent for day 0–45, with staged taper), and whether we can treat the first 45 days as excluded from automated throttling (but still subject to safety limits)? If finance/legal need a PO or addendum, let's list the minimal docs so Michelle can move quickly.

Michelle — I'll try to get a provisional yes/no within 24–36 hours assuming the usage file gives the expected shape.

— Vivek

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-14 11:05 -0700
Subject: internal: LumenAI accelerator exception (provisional parameters)

Marissa/Ben — internal note (Michelle's forecast attached). Proposed provisional terms for review: 

- Velocity top-up: 150k token-equivalent credit upfront for cohort launch (day 0–45).
- Vesting: 60% available immediately, 40% released linearly over day 15–45 to prevent burst abuse.
- Metering leniency: exempt from our rate-based throttle for up to 5 short bursts (each <= 10 minutes) in the 0–45 day window; safety caps still apply to prevent runaway cost.
- Retention incentive: additional 25k credit grant if LumenAI signs a paid commitment within 180 days; otherwise unused credits expire at 6 months.

Questions for ops/legal/finance: 
1) Can billing create a provisional digital addendum (one-page) that signs onto the free-credit carveout without requiring full MSA renegotiation?
2) Any regulatory/compliance flags for treating early traffic as "promotional" vs billed?
3) Do we want to require a minimal spend or PO to enable the top-up?

I've attached a draft proposal template (proposal-draft.docx) that we can use for a lightweight addendum. If everyone agrees in principle, I'll send finalized terms to Michelle and ask for written acceptance.

— Vivek

---
Attachment: proposal-draft.docx (docx)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-15 10:22 -0700
Subject: Re: internal: LumenAI accelerator exception (provisional parameters)

Thanks Vivek — good summary. From the programs side here's a workable carveout that aligns with our prior accelerator playbook but with extra clarity for finance/legal: 

Proposed program terms (recommended):
- Upfront grant: 150k token-equivalent (one-time) applied to account on Day 0.
- Release schedule: 90k (60%) immediate, 60k (40%) released over 30 days (linear).
- Spike windows: allow up to five burst windows up to 10 minutes each where we suspend the automatic minute-based throttle. Bursts still capped by a hard token-per-day ceiling (set by finance).
- Sunset & expiration: any unused promotional credits expire 6 months from issuance; no refunds or rollover.
- Retention incentive: 25k bonus credits if customer executes a paid commitment (min term 3 months or $X ARR equivalent) within 180 days.
- Billing/conversion: finance to issue a small addendum (digital) that references RDW-DEAL-4821 and records the credit grant and conversion trigger; legal to confirm no changes to MSA necessary — just an addendum signed by customer rep.

Operational asks: Ben — can you confirm the hard daily token ceiling we should set for the spike windows? I propose $3k/day token-equivalent converted for now (we can tighten after review). Also, finance needs to confirm how to reflect the promotional grant on billing (contra-revenue vs deferred credit).

Marissa

---Quoted from Vivek Kulkarni on 2026-09-14 11:03---

> 
> High level: we can consider a provisional velocity top-up plus a conversion-linked retention incentive...

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-16 15:22 -0700
Subject: Re: internal: LumenAI accelerator exception (provisional parameters)

Okay — finance sign-off in principle with these constraints: 

1) Hard daily ceiling: $3,000 token-equivalent per day during approved burst windows (convert using our current public rate card).
2) Accounting: treat the 150k grant as a promotional credit (contra-revenue) that posts when issued; retention bonus (25k) is conditional liability until conversion trigger is met.
3) Procurement: require a PO or signed addendum referencing RDW-DEAL-4821 and including the conversion terms before we apply the top-up. PO can be a one-page doc; legal can confirm signatory thresholds.

Marissa — once legal signs off on the addendum language, I can have billing set up the promo credit and flag it to expire after 6 months. Vivek — please ask Michelle to confirm acceptance in writing (email OK) so this can be attached to the addendum.

HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/78910 (I've added the provisional terms to the deal note).

Ben
